hash_policy: Pinned sha256/size are enforced. Hugging Face entries were resolved on 2026-09-27 by the Windows CI integration job (scripts/ci_integration.py: HF API LFS metadata + model-card licence). Non-LFS JSON files carry size only. The Apple SHARP checkpoint has no published hash: it is recorded on first download (trust-on-first-use).

models.display_name: MoGe-3 ViT-L — the photo's geometry for Real 3D (sharper, better scale and focal)
models.license: MIT (Hugging Face model card: license: mit)
models.notes: Real 3D (rc48): depth, field of view and metric scale of the original photo; runs in photo-cu128 (FlexGEMM Triton kernels). MoGe-2 is used when it is not installed.

models.display_name: MoGe-3 Giant — the photo's geometry for Real 3D, most accurate (used for photos when installed)
models.license: MIT (Hugging Face model card: license: mit)
models.notes: Real 3D (2.0.0-rc7): MoGe-3 with the ViT-G backbone (1.25B parameters, same code as MoGe-3 Large); photos use it instead of the Large model when it is installed. Splat videos keep the Large model (speed).

models.display_name: Apple Depth Pro — a second measured depth for Real 3D photos (sharp edges, lens check)
models.license: Apple Machine Learning Research Model License (apple-amlr: research purposes only, non-commercial)
models.notes: Real 3D (2.0.0-rc7): metric depth with the sharpest object boundaries and its own focal-length estimate (Bochkovskii et al., ICLR 2025). Joined to MoGe-3 (overall shape from both, edges from Depth Pro) and used to check the EXIF lens. Same file as https://ml-site.cdn-apple.com/models/depth-pro/depth_pro.pt (same SHA256).

models.display_name: YuNet face detector — real-world scale check for Real 3D (eye distance)
models.notes: Real 3D (rc56): finds faces and eyes (OpenCV FaceDetectorYN, CPU) so the photo's measured depth can be checked against the adult eye distance (56-70 mm).

models.display_name: Sapiens2-1B Pointmap — people's 3D shape for Real 3D
models.license: Sapiens2 License (Meta; Hugging Face card: license other / sapiens2-license)
models.notes: Real 3D (rc58): per-pixel 3D of people (Meta Sapiens2, ICLR 2026, trained on 1B human images and synthetic scans) - faces, noses and bodies with their real relief; also a distance cue for the real-world scale. Runs in photo-cu128 (vendored backbone, workers/sapiens2_backbone.py).

models.display_name: Sapiens2-1B surface normals — people's fine relief for Real 3D
models.license: Sapiens2 License (Meta; Hugging Face card: license other / sapiens2-license)
models.notes: Real 3D (2.0.0-rc7): per-pixel surface normals of people (camera frame) - folds of clothes, fingers, the relief of a face - joined to their depth as its slopes. Same vendored backbone as the pointmap model; NormalHead checked against sapiens.dense (parameter names and shapes identical to the checkpoint).

models.display_name: Sapiens2-0.4B body-part segmentation — where the people are, for Real 3D
models.license: Sapiens2 License (Meta; Hugging Face card: license other / sapiens2-license)
models.notes: Real 3D (rc58): outline of the people (29 body parts, 0 = background) so Sapiens2's shape is used only on them.

models.display_name: Apple SHARP — single image to 3D Gaussians
models.license: Apple Machine Learning Research Model License (research purposes only, non-commercial)
models.notes: Research-only. Never bundled. Enabled only when the user selects the research/personal license profile and accepts the Apple model license. Splatline reports ~2.5 GB.
